title: Photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make sugars. Oxygen is released as a by-product. Chlorophyll absorbs light energy for this process.

title: प्रकाश संश्लेषण
text: प्रकाश संश्लेषण वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश, पानी और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड से भोजन बनाते हैं। इस प्रक्रिया में ऑक्सीजन निकलती है।

title: ದ್ಯುತಿಸಂಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ
text: ದ್ಯುತಿಸಂಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕು, ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಡೈಆಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಬಳಸಿ ಆಹಾರ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಈ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title: Mars
text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. It is often called the Red Planet because iron minerals in its soil give it a reddish appearance.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation retrieves relevant source passages before generating an answer. Grounded systems should cite the passages used as evidence and decline to answer when evidence is insufficient.
